predictions.selection_reason: Untrusted input values -> direct property assignment without validation -> potential prototype pollution
predictions.source_summary: Values come from user-provided objects passed to deepMixin function. The 'key' parameter comes from forOwn iteration over source object properties.
predictions.sink_summary: Direct assignment to object prototype via 'this[key]' where 'this' is the target object and 'key' can be '__proto__' or 'constructor.prototype'.
predictions.guard_summary: No validation of 'key' parameter. isObject checks only validate values, not property names. forOwn iterates own properties but doesn't prevent prototype pollution keys.
predictions.risk_pattern: Untrusted property names from source objects can overwrite Object.prototype properties, enabling prototype pollution attacks.
used_variable_sources: forOwn iteration over source object properties
called_function_context: forOwn(obj, copy, o) - calls copy with target object 'o' as context
predictions.context_summary: The copy function is called by forOwn with target object 'o' as 'this' context. Property assignment occurs when either value or existing property is not a plain object.
unresolved_facts: Specific usage patterns of deepMixin function in real applications
Whether input objects are validated before being passed to deepMixin

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Deep object merging function assigns untrusted property keys to target object without validation of special prototype properties
retrieval_query.sensitive_operation: recursive property assignment via this[key] = value
retrieval_query.missing_control: sanitization of property names like __proto__, constructor, prototype
retrieval_query.impact: modification of Object.prototype leading to security vulnerabilities

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
top_sast_rules.description: Functions recursively assigning properties on objects may be the cause of accidental modification of a built-in prototype object.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
